findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/provider-process-registry.ts:228-232 drops a replacement occupant from occupiedCount when a reclaimable slot changes between the initial and ownership reads. With the cap lowered and a live replacement in a high-index slot, acquireProviderProcessSlot can then create slot-0 and exceed the configured shared cap. Re-read mismatch must be counted or restart/fail closed, with a replacement-between-reads race test.

packages/main/src/handlers/managed-review-evidence.ts:143-157 computes liveHeadHash but never compares it and intentionally admits same-material HEAD advancement; packages/main/src/tasks/managed-review-evidence-smoke.ts:811-878 pins that behavior. CHK-006:edge:1 requires changed head lineage to invalidate both fresh import and REVIEW revalidation. Restrict the metadata-import exception to mechanically proven importer commits or require re-review.

packages/main/src/handlers/managed-review-evidence.ts:143-150 rejects live drift in a handler-local branch before shared intake at line 175, while packages/main/src/core/review-run.ts:1440-1455 returns stale_run_hash before verifyManagedReviewEvidence at line 1531. Import and REVIEW consumption therefore do not classify freshness through one Proof Admissibility evaluator and canonical reason family as required by CHK-006:adversarial:2 and CHK-006:edge:1.

packages/main/src/core/provider-process-registry.ts:546-547 recognizes child-process use only when source contains the literal node:child_process; a valid import from child_process followed by spawn('codex') evades inventory, while packages/main/src/tasks/provider-execution-inventory-contract.ts:47-60 and 101-106 pin only the node-prefixed form. This breaks CHK-004:adversarial:0's guarantee that every new direct provider spawn fails the contract until classified and admitted.

packages/main/src/handlers/delivery-check.ts:211-220 makes delivery_check_set depend on the new native broker authorization at packages/main/src/core/delivery-review-authority.ts:119-137, but neither file is authorized by B-137a's allowedCreate/allowedModify scope and CHK-001 through CHK-007 do not specify a delivery-check migration. This unscoped behavior change rejects previously valid unbrokered delivery reviewers and can block DONE; add an authorized migration and user-facing contract or revert it.

packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:1334 silently swallows marker-bound scratch cleanup mutation failures without a health or status diagnostic. This leaves a git worktree retained invisibly until a later GC attempt and violates AGENTS.md:591-596's requirement that persistence/mutation failures remain observable.
packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:50 imports readFileSync but never uses it after the slot-reading refactor. Remove the dead import so the module's dependencies remain accurate.

readManifest.scanEscalationReason: Candidate routing was shadow-only with cutoff ties and omitted central managed-run, managed-review, delivery-authority, and provider-inventory changes, so the review escalated to those changed sources.
